title: Nutritious Japanese Cassaba Bowl
description: A delicious and nutritious Japanese dish featuring cassaba, shio-koji-cure and flavorful sesame seeds. This recipe is also Jain-friendly, which means no onions, garlic, mushrooms, eggs, or any other root vegetables from the Allium family are used.

ingredients.name: Shio-koji
ingredients.notes: available at Asian grocery stores or online

ingredients.name: Kombu
ingredients.notes2: available at Asian grocery stores or online

instructions: Cut the cassaba into bite-sized pieces and set aside.
In a small bowl, mix together the shio-koji, sesame seeds, and a pinch of salt.
In a large saucepan, combine the coconut oil, rice vinegar, maple syrup, ginger, and kombu.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the cassaba to the saucepan and cook for an additional 10-12 minutes, or until the cassaba is tender and slightly caramelized.
Season the dish with salt to taste and serve hot, garnished with sesame oil and additional sesame seeds if desired.
